label: M 20 (lost about noon)

label: C 04 (lost about noon)

label: M 56 (Acquafondata, occupied)
source: Bezugspunktkarte, January 1944 edition, decoded with tools/bezugspunkt.py (jan1944.csv)
note: "Vor neuer Widerstandslinie des G.J.R.100 hat nachdrängender Feind M 41, Höhe 1 km nordwestlich M 41, Höhen südwestlich und westlich M 56 besetzt" (in front of the new line of resistance of Gebirgsjäger-Regiment 100, the enemy, following up, occupied M 41, the height 1 km north-west of M 41, and the heights south-west and west of M 56). M 56 is Acquafondata, where Battery F moved on 20 Jan. Named in t314-0543/f0697.
